# Agent incident review

## Summary

- **Incident/date/severity:**
- **Impact and affected tenants:**
- **Current status:**
- **Owners:**

Use precise effect counts and data classifications. Do not include secrets or unnecessary personal data.

## Timeline

| Time (UTC)   | Event/evidence | Actor or component |
| ------------ | -------------- | ------------------ |
| _YYYY-MM-DD_ | _Event_        | _Actor_            |

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe the intended policy, action, and user-visible outcome, then the observed difference.

## Control-path reconstruction

- Initiating principal and tenant
- Input and retrieved-content provenance
- Model/prompt/policy/tool versions
- Proposed actions
- Policy decisions and approvals
- External receipts and ambiguous outcomes
- Final response shown to the user

## Contributing factors

Separate proximate trigger, technical causes, organizational conditions, and detection gaps. Avoid assigning blame.

## Containment and recovery

Document capability revocation, tool/read-only switches, data quarantine, reconciliation, compensation, user notification, and evidence preservation.

## Corrective actions

| Action   | Type (prevent/detect/recover) | Owner   | Due date     | Verification   |
| -------- | ----------------------------- | ------- | ------------ | -------------- |
| _Action_ | _Type_                        | _Owner_ | _YYYY-MM-DD_ | _Success test_ |

## Evaluation updates

Add sanitized regression cases, the invariant they assert, and the suite version containing them.

## Lessons and residual risk

State what changed in the mental model and what risk remains accepted, by whom, until when.
